name: lookout
description: Claude Code sessions and usage limits in the status bar: what is working, what waits for you, and how much of the 5-hour and weekly limits is used, across every window and terminal.

enumDescriptions: Every session on this computer, grouped by window in the tooltip.
Only sessions running in this window.
lookout.scope.markdownDescription: Which Claude Code sessions the status bar shows.

lookout.limits.showWeekly.markdownDescription: Show the weekly limit next to the 5-hour limit.

lookout.limits.thresholds.markdownDescription: Usage levels, in percent. From the lowest one the limits item turns yellow and a notification says the limit is getting close; from the highest one it turns red and shows when the limit resets.

lookout.notifications.needsYou.markdownDescription: Notify when a session waits for you: a permission prompt, a question or another dialog.

lookout.notifications.finished.markdownDescription: Notify when a session finishes a turn that took at least `#lookout.notifications.finishedAfterSeconds#` seconds.

lookout.notifications.finishedAfterSecon.markdownDescription: How long a turn must take before its end is worth a notification.

lookout.notifications.limitNear.markdownDescription: Notify when the 5-hour or weekly limit reaches one of `#lookout.limits.thresholds#`.

lookout.notifications.limitReset.markdownDescription: Notify when a limit that reached the highest threshold resets.

enumDescriptions: Only when no editor window is in front.
lookout.notifications.system.markdownDescription: Also show notifications in macOS Notification Center. They come from a system helper, so they carry the Script Editor icon, and clicking one opens Script Editor; the editor's own notification has the buttons.

scripts.package: npm run build -- --production && vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/lookout.vsix
